evidence.notes: Set only after the privacy, terms, contact and retention policy set has completed the required legal/Arabic review and effective dates are published.
All 24 required EN/AR Android/iOS screenshots were captured from rendered UI, visually approved, committed, and reconciled at 1080x1920 with SHA-256 fingerprints.
Requires final comparison of Apple App Privacy and Google Data safety answers against the production SDK/provider inventory and approved privacy policy.
Requires Android private testing and iOS TestFlight testing to complete without release-blocking defects.
Requires the real Apple/Google store records, categories, distribution, content-rating forms and review contacts to be configured.
Requires dedicated reviewer credentials to be provisioned outside source control and supplied only through the store review consoles.

completionRule: status may be ready only when every required evidence item has status approved, a non-empty evidenceReference, and an ISO-8601 approvedAt timestamp.
